hub.upgrade.reason.release_script: This machine runs a version published by ops/release.sh under launchd, without the managed upgrader (ops/run-managed.sh), so the Hub can't replace and restart itself. Upgrade with the release script.
hub.upgrade.reason.source: The Hub runs from a source build with no managed upgrader to switch versions and restart it. Update the source, build and restart yourself.
hub.upgrade.reason.external: Can't tell how this machine was installed (a container or another deployment system, for example), or STEVE_INSTALL_KIND=external is set. Steve doesn't touch its files or processes; upgrade it in the deployment system.
hub.upgrade.reason.keychain: This supervisor launch cannot preserve the macOS Keychain signing identity. Use the signed-service launch with the existing identity; recompilation and key-store migration are not required.

hub.upgrade.already_decided: The upgrade was already approved or has ended
hub.upgrade.reject_pending_only: Only an upgrade request awaiting approval can be rejected
hub.upgrade.reason.local_missing: Downloading and installing a release with this installation’s signing identity also needs: %{missing}. Resolve these prerequisites to upgrade here. The current version and keys are unchanged.
hub.upgrade.stable_only: Only a published stable release can be installed
hub.upgrade.local.unknown_current: The running version %{current} can't be compared with a release, so it can't be rebuilt automatically
hub.upgrade.local.not_newer: %{version} isn't newer than the running %{current}: a local build only moves to a newer release
hub.upgrade.local.release_running: Another release is running (releases/.release.lock is held). Upgrade once it has finished
hub.upgrade.local.gone: The upgrade process exited without a result; the running version was not switched. See the log %{log}
hub.upgrade.local.gone_switched: Upgrade committed, but the upgrade process exited before writing its result; the new version is in place and was not rolled back. See the log %{log}
hub.upgrade.local.python_old: %{python} can't extract archives safely (Python 3.12 or later is needed, in /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin or /usr/bin). Nothing was changed
hub.upgrade.local.untrusted_home: Signed upgrades support this account’s authorized installation at %{home}; this request uses %{got}, so no update was installed. The current version and keys are unchanged.
hub.upgrade.local.untrusted_python: %{python} isn't a Python from the system's or Homebrew's directories, so it doesn't get the signing keychain's password and nothing was built. Nothing was changed
hub.upgrade.local.release_other: The release manifest of %{version} comes from %{source} and names %{commit}, not what this upgrade recorded, so nothing was built. Nothing was changed
hub.upgrade.local.release_unconfirmed: The release manifest of %{version} could not be read again (%{error}); it is checked before anything is signed, so nothing was built. Nothing was changed
hub.upgrade.local.tag_mismatch: Tag %{tag} points at %{got}, not %{commit} from the release manifest, so nothing was built. Nothing was changed
hub.upgrade.local.commit_missing: The checkout doesn't have the release commit %{commit} and fetching the tag failed. Nothing was changed
hub.upgrade.local.candidate_incomplete: %{dir} exists but isn't a complete build; inspect and remove it, then try again. Nothing was changed
hub.upgrade.local.build_failed: The local build failed (exit code %{code}); the running version is unchanged. See the log %{log}
hub.upgrade.local.deploy_refused: The deploy stopped before switching; the running version and database are unchanged. See the log %{log}
hub.upgrade.local.rolled_back: The deploy failed and the previous version and database were restored. See the log %{log}
hub.upgrade.local.committed_failed: Upgrade committed, but the new version didn't come up properly; it stays in place and was not rolled back. See the log %{log}
hub.upgrade.local.not_recovered: The deploy failed and the previous version didn't come back; it needs fixing by hand. See the log %{log}

hub.workspaces.outside: Not under a directory of this machine's Node
hub.node.stranger: The Node has unfinished work for this session that the Hub has no record of (the Hub's data may have gone back to an earlier state). The session is paused: no new commands are sent, and that work is not given up on its own
hub.node.restart_abandon: The Node running this attempt restarted and its process is gone. Steve is giving the attempt up; once the Node confirms, the agent carries on. The turn is never sent again.
hub.node.control_unknown: The Node cannot tell whether %{what} finished (%{detail}). The session waits for reconciliation and nothing is sent again. Press Stop to retract it.
hub.node.release_retry: The previous session has not been released on the Node yet. This session opens once it is; retrying
hub.node.quarantined: An event from the Node conflicts with what is saved and was set aside for diagnosis. This session applies no more Node events and will not recover by itself; its last turn's outcome is unknown and it is never run again. Continue in a new session, or close this one.
hub.node.config_unknown: The config change has an unknown outcome. The session waits for reconciliation and nothing is sent again; press Stop to retract it
hub.node.gap: The Hub holds fewer Node events than the Node confirmed delivering (the Hub's data may have gone back to an earlier state), and the missing ones cannot be fetched again. The session stops applying Node events until this is handled and does not run again meanwhile
hub.node.ahead: The Hub holds more Node events than the Node has now (the Node's records may have gone back to an earlier state). The session stops applying Node events until this is handled and does not run again meanwhile
hub.node.lagging: The Hub could not apply this session's Node events in time. The session is paused and sends no new commands; it continues once they are applied
hub.node.recover_failed: Retracting the operation with an unknown outcome did not succeed (%{detail}); the Node's state needs checking by hand. The session stays paused; press Stop again to retry.
hub.node.recovered_released: Retracted %{what}, whose outcome was unknown; what it did on the Node is still unknown (not counted as a success). The session was released; the next message opens it again.
hub.node.recovered_release_again: Retracted %{what}, whose outcome was unknown; what it did on the Node is still unknown (not counted as a success). The session that takes over waits for it to be let go, so it is asked again.
hub.node.recovered_prepare: Retracted %{what}, whose outcome was unknown; what it did on the Node is still unknown (not counted as a success). The workspace is prepared again before the session opens.
hub.node.recovered_abandon: Retracted %{what}, whose outcome was unknown; this run's outcome is still unknown. Press Stop again to give it up.
hub.node.recovered_permission: Retracted %{what}, whose outcome was unknown; whether the permission took effect is still unknown.
hub.node.stop.deadline: The run went past its time limit; the Node stopped it
hub.node.stop.job_deadline: The job went past its time limit; the Node stopped it
hub.node.stop.hub_unreachable: The Node could not reach the Hub past the lease and stopped the run
hub.node.stop.output_limit: The output went past this run's limit; the Node stopped it
hub.node.stop.frame_too_large: The harness sent a message larger than 1 MiB; the Node stopped the run
hub.node.stop.ingress_stalled: The Node took none of the harness's output for %{secs} s (its journal or disk is stuck) and interrupted the run
hub.node.stop.journal_budget: The Node's journal reached its data budget; the run was stopped
hub.node.stop.journal_fails: The Node's journal failed to write; the run was stopped
hub.node.stop.not_recorded: The Node could not record the harness's output and stopped the run
hub.node.stop.harness_idle: The harness said nothing for too long and was stopped
hub.node.stop.research_budget: The research used up its turns or tool calls
hub.node.stop.reopen_failed: The Node could not open the session again: %{detail}
hub.node.adopted: This session moved from the legacy runner to the Node and continues the same conversation.
hub.node.adopted_fresh: This session moved from the legacy runner to the Node. The legacy runner left no conversation to continue, so it starts a new one.
hub.node.retired: This session cannot move to the Node (%{why}), so it has ended. A message in the item starts a new session.
hub.node.unbound.read_only: it is a read-only imported session
hub.node.unbound.not_here: it is not a Steve session on this machine
hub.node.unbound.no_item: it belongs to no item in this workspace
hub.node.unbound.bot: its bot is disabled, deleted or in another workspace
hub.node.unbound.mode: the Node does not support its permission mode %{mode}
hub.node.unbound.outside_roots: its working directory is not one the Node may use
hub.node.unbound.missing_cwd: its working directory no longer exists
hub.node.refused: This session cannot run on a Node (%{why}). The Hub no longer runs sessions itself, so the message was not sent.
hub.node.unbound.stopped: the local Node is not running
hub.node.unbound.unreadable: its records could not be read just now
hub.node.unbound.bind_failed: binding it to the Node failed
hub.node.takeover_suspected: The link of device “%{name}” was taken over repeatedly within a minute, as if someone else holds its key. Steve has paused it. Check it in Devices: if only your own machine runs it, change its key there with steve-node rotate; otherwise revoke the device.

hub.node.remote.refused: The remote Node %{node} does not take this work: %{why}
